item.name: GitHub Get All Requested Reviewers for Pull Request

request.name: GitHub Get All Requested Reviewers for Pull Request

description.content: Gets the users or teams whose review is requested for a pull request. Once a requested reviewer submits a review, they are no longer considered a requested reviewer. Their review will instead be returned by the [List reviews for a pull request](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/pulls/reviews#list-reviews-for-a-pull-request) operation.
